title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer - Commerce
searchText: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer - Commerce Flexport About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity : We're seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer with a passion for transforming data from our new client-facing services and pricing products into actionable insights to further improve our products. This team builds solutions for customers who are looking to understand Flexport service capabilities and pricing, putting you at the center of defining new processes, consolidating data, and helping drive client conversion. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with engineering, business, and product stakeholders to dive deep into existing data, help define new data needed to drive pricing elasticity decisions, and build dashboards/reports to inform and drive behavior within Flexport and with our clients. Key Responsibilities: Meet with our customers to gain a deep understanding of how they view our services/pricing and how Flexport can use our data to help answer their questions Work closely with our business, operations, and technology teams to build datasets, metrics and reports to make data driven decisions Become a domain expert: Understand the market, competitive landscape, and how Flexport fits into it all Collaborate with a cross-functional team to define product requirements and translate them into effective design solutions for new products focused on order management and booking management tools. Job Requirements: 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, BI Engineer, Product Analyst, or similar role Strong SQL fluency required – you will be building complex logic to extract and transform data into actionable insights. Experience with Looker and Snowflake a plus. Experience collaborating with business, product, engineering teams to define and develop operational and product metrics. Executive communication skills and empathy to understand and discover business pain points and build solutions to improve the user experience at all levels of the global trade process Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
